description: REEF3D::HYDRO catchment model coupled with SFLOW (R 100 2): a 2000 m valley of 20 hydrology cells of 100 m (DIVEMesh W 10, flow paths in hydro_grid.dat version 2), SFLOW semi-implicit on the lower 1000 m (10 m cells, free outfall), 36 mm/h for 1 h through pass-through HBV; the runoff of the cells under SFLOW and the discharge of the upstream chain enter SFLOW every 60 s, the outflow leaves the catchment. REEF3D-HYDRO-Coupled.dat, the budgets and the gauges as text (validation HYDRO/validation/08_coupling: the coupling closes to 1e-10 m3).
covers: hydro_couple: overlap, entry points, sources C, cut steps, coupled budget
sflow_momentum_SI: closed open boundary faces without old discharge
